reportprom.description: Produce prometheus metrics of backup status.

emailto.description: Email address (local part only) to receive backup reports.

reportsuccess.description: Send email report even if all modules succeeded.

reportinfo.description: Include info messages from handlers in email reports.

reportwarning.description: Send email report even if there were no errors.

reportspace.description: Include disk space usage in backup email reports.

reporthost.description: Remote host to rsync backupninja logs for aggregation. Empty string means disabled.

masterlogfile.description: Where the main backupninja log file is located.

tmpdir.description: Directory where all the backup configuration files live.
